WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE
What We Do
Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.
What You'll Do
Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Language Programmer to join our Verse team, which owns the toolchain (compiler, VM, and runtime) that powers game development in Unreal Engine and UEFN. You'll work on the systems every UE and UEFN developer relies on to build and ship games with Verse.
In this role, you will
Extend, evolve, and maintain the Verse compiler toolchain, transactional memory runtime and VM, add new platform support, implement new language features and integrate with Unreal Engine's content, build, and cooking pipelines
Optimize performance, memory usage, and iteration times across the Verse toolchain, runtime and UE/Verse boundary
Work closely with language consumers to ensure an exceptional user experience
Establish test workflows to validate improvements and prevent regressions
Design and maintain the scripting interface to Unreal Engine, working in close collaboration with the Verse Language team and the broader UE engineering organization
What we're looking for
Expert knowledge of C++17 or later
Experience in compiler or toolchain development (e.g., compiler internals, VM design, Clang/LLVM, or linker/platform ABI specifics)
Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power
Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
Solid grounding in software engineering principles, including API design
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions
Experience with Unreal Engine integration is a plus
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.
Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.
ABOUT US
Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.
Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit
www.bitgo.com
.
This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.
BitGo is looking for a design leader who still designs. You will manage and mentor the design team, own the design system, and sit next to the Chief Product Officer on business strategy.
This is a player-coach role, and we mean it literally. You will carry your own design surfaces and ship them, alongside leading the team. Expect roughly 50% hands-on IC work to start, decreasing as the team scales. It will not go to zero — the person setting the craft bar should be practicing at it.
We are not a design-forward company today. We intend to become one, and we want you to lead that shift.
The team you will lead
The design team is small, senior, and self-sufficient. Each designer owns a wide vertical outright — trading, staking, DeFi vaults, earn, wallets, financing — with deep product context and strong opinions about the work. They are running at capacity, which is part of why this role carries real IC load: you will pick up the retail mobile experience and design system rather than distributing that work across a team that is already full.
What they have asked for is specific, and we are hiring against it: a leader who gets into the work early with product and engineering rather than arriving at the end, who can critique craft because they still practice it, who tells them plainly what the next level requires, and who gives the team air cover so they can do the deep work instead of patching to hit dates.
What you will own
Your own design work.
You will own surfaces directly and ship them at the quality bar you are asking of everyone else. Discovery through spec, in Figma, in the reviews, on the hard problems.
The team's growth.
Invest in each designer individually. Be explicit about what the next level requires and give people the work that gets them there. Feedback should be candid, specific, and about the craft. Respect the ownership designers already have — autonomy is how this team works best, and your job is to raise the ceiling, not take the pen.
Design's standing in the company.
Amplify the team's visibility, voice, and strategic impact. Represent design in strategy, roadmap, and architecture conversations, and push for the client experience when nobody else in the room will.
Upstream involvement.
Join product and engineering at discovery, not at handoff. Shape long-term roadmaps with PMs so the team builds toward a direction instead of absorbing late changes.
The design system.
Own the system and component library end to end: tokens, patterns, governance, contribution model, and adoption across product teams. Translate company strategy into a system flexible enough that teams ship scalable experiences rather than one-off patches.
Systems design.
Our platform spans seven product areas with shared primitives — accounts, wallets, assets, entitlements, approvals. Design the system, not the screen.
The discipline.
Establish UX and systems thinking as a practice the whole organization runs on, not a stage a design team owns. Product managers, engineers, and business leads should be able to frame a client problem, map the system it lives in, and evaluate a solution against real client needs. That is how we ship value to every client type we serve, in every market we operate in — rather than a set of features that work for the loudest account.
How we work.
Establish the processes a small team needs to move fast without losing quality: critique, documentation, design review, and clean handoffs with engineering. Set the quality bar and hold it, including for AI-assisted work.
Technical depth.
Read a technical design, understand the constraint, and decide with engineering where to compromise, where to hold, and where a broader change is worth the cost. Get into the mechanics with the team on the hard edge cases — the crypto ones and the design ones.
The face of design.
Be present and known internally, and represent BitGo design externally with clients, partners, and candidates.
What success looks like
By six months:
the design system has a clear owner, a versioned component library, and measurable adoption. Product teams stop reinventing patterns. You have shipped design work of your own that the team points to as the standard. Every designer knows what their next level requires and has work that supports getting there.
By 12 months:
design is in the room early on strategy, not late on execution. Product and engineering partners frame problems in client terms without being asked. The team has grown in size and capability. At least one flagship surface has shipped with a coherent, systemized experience clients notice.
Who you are
Experience leading design in financial services. Digital assets, or another domain of genuinely complex technical flows, strongly preferred.
You have built and owned a design system at scale, not just used one.
Hands-on in Figma and a role model for craft. You are shipping design work today, not describing work you shipped four years ago. You can sit in a critique and give feedback that is specific enough to act on.
Deep in UX. Strong product thinking, logical reasoning, and decisions grounded in data rather than taste alone.
You have managed designers and made them better. You care about how the team is doing, not only what it ships.
Technically literate. Comfortable with APIs, data models, and engineering trade-offs.
Direct communicator. You can hold a position with a Chief Product Officer, an engineering lead, or a client, and change your mind when the argument is better.
You want the mandate. Turning a technical, compliance-heavy platform into a design-led one is the appeal, not the obstacle.
Helpful, not required
Regulated environments: broker-dealer, trust company, bank, or qualified custodian.
Experience with complex permissioning, approval workflows, or multi-entity account structures.
Design leadership at a company that went through the same shift you would lead here.
Why Join BitGo?
Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.
Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
Up to 4% 401k company match
Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
Free commuter/parking pass
Free custom lunches and snacks
Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
Great colleagues and an inspiring environment
Benefits may vary based on location.
Pay Transparency Notice:
Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $210,000 and $250,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.
Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

jobs.description:
회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
Detection Engineering(DE) 팀은 쿠팡 보안조직(Digital Trust) 내에서 보안 위협의 탐지와 대응 자동화를 엔드투엔드로 설계하고 구현하는 팀입니다. 위협 시나리오 정의부터 로그 수집, 탐지 룰 배포, AI 기반 자동 대응까지 전 주기를 한 팀에서 커버하며, Detection-as-Code 철학을 기반으로 모든 탐지 로직을 코드로 관리합니다.
DE팀은 AI 기술을 각 도메인에 적극적으로 접목하고 있습니다. AI-SOC를 직접 구현하고, 보안 로그의 AI 기반 분석, LLM을 활용한 자동화 등, AI는 별도 기능이 아닌 팀 전체의 업무 방식에 내재되어 있습니다.
이 포지션은 SIEM과 SOAR를 아우르는 보안 탐지·자동화 전 영역에서 깊은 기술적 전문성을 발휘하는 역할입니다. 데이터 파이프라인부터 탐지 엔진, 자동화 워크플로우, AI-SOC까지 DE팀의 기술 스택 전체를 관통하는 시야로 아키텍처 설계와 기술적 난제 해결에 기여합니다.
이런 분과 함께하고 싶습니다
하나의 도메인에 갇히지 않고, 데이터부터 자동화까지 전체를 조망할 수 있는 분
"이게 왜 이렇게 되어 있지?"라는 질문에서 시작해 아키텍처를 개선한 경험이 있는 분

jobs.description: Location: Letterkenny (Hybrid 2-3 days In Office) What you will do Our Technology Solutions Group is a dynamic, fast-paced environment, with exciting changes on the horizon under new senior leadership. Standardize CI/CD on GitHub Actions by building reusable workflows/composite actions, defining runner strategy, and enforcing environment protections/approvals and required quality gates; automate build, test, security checks, and progressive delivery (blue/green, canary) to enable developer self-service. Develop automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, source code management and new ways to operate and collaborate; implement Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation and Terraform. Use role-relevant languages and frameworks such as Python, Shell/PowerShellplus Groovy/JavaScript as needed for pipeline automation. Implement GitOps-based deployment patterns and environment promotion workflows; establish guardrails for configuration, secrets, and change management across environments. Partner with engineering and leadership on FinOps practices: cost allocation/tagging standards, budget alerts, showback/chargeback reporting, rightsizing and scheduling, and optimization of compute/storage/network spend. Drive DevSecOps and Security Operations alignment by partnering with security teams on detection and response (triage, containment, postmortems), improving platform hardening and access controls, and ensuring audit-ready logging and monitoring. Define and operationalize SRE practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, on-call readiness, runbooks, automated remediation, and service health dashboards leveraging modern observability tooling. In addition to deep technical expertise and engineering mindset, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong desire to new tools and technology and an inclusive attitude! What you will bring 5 - 10 years of proven experience in DevOps or Platform Engineering Strong experience with deploying, managing and monitoring services in AWS/Azure Has hands-on experience using source control (Git, GitHub) and feature branching strategies Experience designing and operating CI/CD platforms with GitHub Actions as the primary automation layer (workflow-as-code, reusable workflows/actions, runners, environment protections), plus familiarity integrating or migrating from legacy tooling (e.g., Jenkins) as needed. Understands networking, DNS, routing and messaging, especially between services Experience with microservices and designing observability (metrics, logs, traces) for production services. Working knowledge of cloud security and SecOps processes (IAM, key management, logging/monitoring, vulnerability remediation, incident response) and ability to embed security controls into workflows. Experience applying FinOps concepts in AWS/Azure (cost visibility, tagging, budgeting, forecasting, rightsizing, reserved capacity/savings plans) and communicating cost drivers to engineering stakeholders. Ability to speak to SDLC best practices and industry trends. Familiarity with various Software Engineering domains: Software development processes (Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL, Shell, Infrastructure-as-Code, Configuration-as-Code) Issue tracking and versioning (Jira) Package managers (pip, npm) and Build tools (Gradle, Maven) Containers (Docker, Kubernetes) Infrastructure/config deployment tooling (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible). Artifact repositories (e.g., Artifactory, Nexus, GitHub Packages) CI/CD platform : Jenkins & GitHub Actions GitHub Actions patterns: workflow-as-code (YAML), reusable workflows/actions, runner strategy, environment protections/approvals, secrets + OIDC cloud auth, and artifacts/caching. Continuous delivery & GitOps tooling (e.g., Argo CD, Flux) and Helm/Kustomize-based configuration management. Cloud-native identity, secrets, and configuration: AWS IAM/KMS/SSM Parameter Store/Secrets Manager; Azure Entra ID, Key Vault, and App Configuration. Cloud monitoring/logging: AWS CloudWatch/CloudTrail; Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights (plus integrations with Splunk/Dynatrace/Datadog as applicable). Policy-as-code and compliance automation (e.g., OPA/Gatekeeper, Terraform policy frameworks) and secrets management practices. Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as with Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry etc. Strong verbal communication skills to address both the development community and business leaders. Strong documentation skills to publish user guides, defects, feature requests, and architecture designs.
